result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.max_clique()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Find a maximum clique in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L9985-L10075){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.max_clique() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A maximum clique is a largest possible clique in the graph. If multiple maximum cliques exist with the same size, returns one of them (arbitrary choice). Uses the Bron-Kerbosch algorithm to enumerate all maximal cliques and selects the largest. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Sorted list of node IDs forming a maximum clique. Empty list if graph is empty. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If called on a directed graph. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - time complexity: `O(3^(n/3))` in the worst case - only works on undirected graphs - finding the maximum clique is NP-hard - returns one maximum clique if multiple exist ## Examples {.doc-examples} Maximum clique in a triangle: ::: {#c73766d4 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "A") ) max_clique = graph.max_clique() # Returns 3 (all nodes form a clique) len(max_clique) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Maximum clique in a path graph: ::: {#e781a970 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "D") ) max_clique = graph.max_clique() # Returns 2 (any connected pair) len(max_clique) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: Empty graph: ::: {#5346caa9 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph(directed=False) max_clique = graph.max_clique() # Returns [] max_clique ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` [] ``` ::: ::: Complete graph: ::: {#b5926c9c .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph(directed=False) graph.add_full_graph(n=6) max_clique = graph.max_clique() # Returns 6 (all nodes) len(max_clique) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` 6 ``` ::: :::
